description:
Hushfeed 0.46.0 moves the supported TikTok target to the global 47.0.3 APK. Use that exact version when patching.

What changed:

* Hushfeed is the first row in Settings and privacy again. The patch moves TikTok's existing row instead of creating a duplicate.
* Feed filter now follows TikTok's separate golden and offline cache paths.
* Downloads, playback speed, feed overlays, the share sheet and Inbox use the reviewed 47.0.3 boundaries.
* Feature Gate Lab now treats 47.0.3 as its target and keeps older saved rules disabled until reviewed.
* Diagnostics no longer marks a valid empty comment page or an ordinary post without a survey as a broken hook.
* The optional resource cleanup patches have reviewed 47.0.3 file inventories.

Verification:

* 1,441 extension tests and 244 patch tests passed with no failures or skips. Both Android lint gates passed.
* All 91 patches applied with zero failures to TikTok 47.0.3 and the retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures. The provenance run recorded zero manifest changes on each fixture.
* The final bundle contains the patch DEX plus both nonempty extension DEX payloads.
* A same-key replacement install was exercised on the dedicated Samsung S22 Ultra running Android 16. The account and app data were preserved.
* Feed, comments, share sheet, Inbox, Profile, Settings and privacy, and the Hushfeed settings page were exercised on the phone. All 16 probe-visible hook families reported zero missing anchors.
* Share action visibility and the Inbox search control were changed live, verified after re-entry, then restored to their original values.

Some TikTok behavior still depends on content, account state, region or server rollout. The receipt proves patch application and manifest stability across the retained APKs. It does not claim that every conditional TikTok state appeared on one account.

Requires Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.
